test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: On selling a table for Rs. 210 and Rs. 420 there will be loss of L₁% and L₂ % respectively. If L₁ - L₂ = 7, then what is the cost price of table
solution:
**Given:**

First selling price of a table = Rs. 210

Another selling price of a table = Rs. 420

There will be loss of L1% and L2 % respectively.

L1 - L2 = 7

**Concept Used:**

Cost Price = 100 × Selling Price/(100 - Loss%) 

**Calculation:**

SP₁ = Rs. 210

⇒ CP = 100 × 210/(100 - L₁%) 

⇒ SP₂ = Rs. 420

⇒ CP = 100 × 420/(100 - L₂%) 

Since both CP equal, 

⇒ 100 × 210/(100 - L1%) = 100 × 420/(100 - L2%) 

⇒ 210/(100 - L1%) = 420/(100 - L2%)

⇒ 2(100 - L1%) = (100 - L2%)

⇒ 200 - 2L₁ = 100 - L₂

⇒ 2L₁ - L₂ = 100

Given, L1 - L2 = 7. 

⇒ L₁ = 7 + L₂

Put the value of L₁

⇒ 2(7 + L₂) - L2 = 100

⇒ 14 + 2L₂ - L₂ = 100

⇒ L₂ = 86%

⇒ CP = 100 × 420/(100 - 86) 

⇒ CP = 100 × 420/14

⇒ CP = 100 × 30

⇒ CP = Rs.3000

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
